title: Grateful Dead Live at San Jose Civic Auditorium on 1972-08-20

ai_review.summary: Tin‑canny, vocal‑forward mix and an unremarkable show that will mostly please completists.
ai_review.review: The recording suffers from a tinny character and vocals that sit too high in the mix, making it less enjoyable for most listeners. The performance itself is described only as “decent,” offering nothing especially memorable beyond its rarity. This release may be of interest mainly to collectors who want every Dead show regardless of sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers note significant recording flaws and give low‑to‑moderate star ratings (2 and 3). The show is described as merely decent, providing little musical excitement, leading to an overall below‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vocals are overly prominent and sound tinny; overall mix lacks balance, making the recording less clear.
